CLINICAL PRACTICE DIRECTIVE: MANAGEMENT OF ACUTE SEVERE HYPERKALEMIA
Hospital Medicine Guidelines Committee, National Health Authority
Published 2024.

SUMMARY OF RECOMMENDATIONS:
1. Immediate administration of intravenous calcium gluconate for cardiac membrane stabilization.
2. Regular insulin (10 units) in 50 mL 50% dextrose infused over 15 minutes.
3. Rapid reassessment of serum potassium at 2 hours.
